HELPFUL TO KNOW

A few questions, answered.

Where can I find prices and availability?

Send an enquiry with your selected items, quantities and specifications. Contact our team for current prices and availability; the catalogue presents our product range, not live stock.

Can I buy and pay on this website?

The website helps you prepare a quotation enquiry. There is no online checkout or payment. Review the message, open your email app and send it to our team to discuss the next steps.

What if I cannot find the item I need?

Use the project notes in the enquiry form to describe it, including the size, model or material if known. You can also call us directly.

How do I arrange collection or delivery?

Contact us to discuss collection or delivery for your requirements. Confirm the available options, timing and any charges with our team before making arrangements.
